module: Generic registry of UI app "containers" (topLeft, topCenter, topRight) and of the visibility of each app. The topLeft/topCenter/topRight extensions register with registerContainer; this module keeps the visible/hidden state of each app and notifies the Vue interface via guihooks.trigger on the container's trigger. It saves and restores visibility via onSerialize/onDeserialize (Lua reload) and offers a debug ImGui window.
notes: Old identifiers accepted everywhere: utilityApps -> topLeft, gameplayApps -> topCenter, secondaryApps -> topRight (resolveContainerId).
setVerboseLogging does nothing useful: it simply returns enabled as a boolean without storing anything.
The write functions log an error and return without doing anything if the container or the app is unknown; getAppVisibility then returns false.
onDeserialize calls setAppVisibility again for each app, so it emits one UI trigger per restored app.

resolveContainerId.desc: Converts an old container identifier (utilityApps, gameplayApps, secondaryApps) to the current identifier; returns the argument as is otherwise.

registerContainer.desc: Registers a new container. Requires config.id; refuses (with a warning) an already registered identifier. Copies the apps table (visible forced to boolean).

setAppVisibility.desc: Shows or hides an app of a container and sends {appId, visible, allApps} to the interface via the container's trigger.

appId.desc: App identifier (must be declared in the container).

getAppVisibility.desc: Returns the current visibility of an app (false if container or app unknown).

hideAllApps.desc: Hides all apps of a container, sends {hideAll=true, allApps} to the interface then emits the hook onUIContainerAppsHidden(resolved containerId).

getVisibleApps.desc: Lists the identifiers of the visible apps of a container (order not guaranteed, pairs iteration).

returns.desc: Array of appId; empty if container unknown.

getAvailableApps.desc: Returns a copy of a container's apps table in the form {[appId]={visible=boolean}}.

returns.desc: Copy of the apps; empty if container unknown.

setDebug.desc: Enables or disables the "App Containers Debug" ImGui window (Show/Hide buttons per app, Hide All, Show All).

setVerboseLogging.desc: No real effect: returns enabled converted to a boolean.

onDeserialize.desc: Restore hook after a reload: reapplies the saved visibility via setAppVisibility (accepts old identifiers).

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Unload hook: empties the containers table.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame by the extension system; draws the debug ImGui window only if setDebug(true).
